import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, OnChanges, SimpleChanges, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewChecked } from '@angular/core'; import { ConversationData, ConversationItem, ConversationMessage, isSystemMessage } from '@/app/core/models'; import { MessagesService } from '@/app/core/services/messages.service'; import { highlightText } from '@/app/core/utils/search.utils'; import { RichTextEditorComponent } from '@/app/shared/components/rich-text-editor/rich-text-editor.component'; @Component({ selector: 'app-conversation-detail', styles: [` :host { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } `], template: `

Select a conversation to view messages

{{ conversation.title }}

Updated: {{ conversation.lastUpdated }}
{{ unreadCount }} NEW MESSAGES
{{ formatSystemText(item) }}
{{ item.timestamp }}
` }) export class ConversationDetailComponent implements OnChanges, AfterViewChecked { @Input() messageId: string | null = null; @Input() searchQuery: string = ''; @Output() todoStatusChange = new EventEmitter<{ id: string, hasTodo: boolean }>(); @ViewChild('unreadSeparator') unreadSeparator!: ElementRef; @ViewChild('scrollBottom') scrollBottom!: ElementRef; conversation: ConversationData | null = null; draftContent: string = ''; highlightedMessageId: string | null = null; isMemberDropdownOpen = false; constructor(private messagesService: MessagesService) { } ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges) { if (changes['messageId']) { if (this.messageId) { this.loadConversation(this.messageId); // Restore draft from service this.draftContent = this.messagesService.getDraft(this.messageId); } else { this.conversation = null; this.draftContent = ''; } } } ngAfterViewChecked() { } loadConversation(id: string) { this.messagesService.getConversation(id).subscribe(data => { this.conversation = data; this.handleInitialScroll(); }); } handleInitialScroll() { setTimeout(() => { if (this.unreadSeparator) { this.unreadSeparator.nativeElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'auto', block: 'center' }); } else if (this.scrollBottom) { this.scrollBottom.nativeElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'auto' }); } }, 100); } get unreadCount(): number { if (!this.conversation) return 0; return this.conversation.messages.filter(m => !isSystemMessage(m) && !(m as ConversationMessage).isRead).length; } isFirstUnread(item: ConversationItem): boolean { if (!this.conversation || isSystemMessage(item)) return false; const unreadMessages = this.conversation.messages.filter(m => !isSystemMessage(m) && !(m as ConversationMessage).isRead); return unreadMessages.length > 0 && unreadMessages[0].id === (item as ConversationMessage).id; } get todoMessages(): ConversationMessage[] { if (!this.conversation) return []; return this.conversation.messages .filter((item): item is ConversationMessage => !this.isSystem(item) && !!(item as ConversationMessage).isTodo); } isSystem(item: ConversationItem): boolean { return isSystemMessage(item); } asMessage(item: ConversationItem): ConversationMessage { return item as ConversationMessage; } formatSystemText(item: any): string { const { type, actor, targetUser, organization } = item; const pronoun = this.getGenderPronoun(targetUser); switch (type) { case 'member_added': if (actor === 'System') return `${targetUser} has been added to the conversation`; return `${actor} added ${targetUser} to the conversation`; case 'member_removed': return `${actor} removed ${targetUser} from the conversation`; case 'you_were_added': return `${actor} added You to the conversation`; case 'you_were_removed': return `${actor} removed You from the conversation`; case 'member_left_org': return `${targetUser} was removed from the conversation because ${pronoun} is no longer part of ${organization}`; case 'you_left_org': return `You were removed from the conversation because you are no longer part of ${organization}`; case 'banker_replaced': return `${targetUser} was removed from the conversation as ${pronoun} is no longer assigned to organisation`; default: return 'System notification'; } } getGenderPronoun(name: string): string { const femaleEndings = ['a', 'ia', 'na', 'la', 'cia', 'sia']; const first = (name || '').toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]; if (femaleEndings.some(e => first.endsWith(e))) return 'she'; return 'he'; } getMemberIconName(name: string): string { const bankTerms = ['unicredit', 'wilson thomas', 'rossi mario']; const lower = name.toLowerCase(); if (bankTerms.some(term => lower.includes(term))) return 'member-bank'; if (name.length % 5 === 0 && !lower.includes('(you)')) return 'member-bank'; return 'member-client'; } get sortedParticipants(): string[] { if (!this.conversation?.participantsList) return []; return [...this.conversation.participantsList].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)); } get hasParticipantMatch(): boolean { if (!this.searchQuery || !this.conversation?.participantsList) return false; const query = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(); return this.conversation.participantsList.some(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(query)); } highlightMember(name: string): string { return highlightText(name, this.searchQuery); } getContent(item: ConversationItem): string { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return (item as any).content || ''; } return ''; } getSender(item: ConversationItem): string { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return (item as any).sender || ''; } return ''; } getIsOwn(item: ConversationItem): boolean { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return !!(item as any).isOwn; } return false; } highlight(text: string | undefined): string { return highlightText(text, this.searchQuery); } highlightContent(content: string): string { if (!this.searchQuery) return content; return highlightText(content, this.searchQuery); } scrollToMessage(id: string) { this.highlightedMessageId = id; setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('message-' + id); if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }); } // Remove highlight after a few seconds setTimeout(() => this.highlightedMessageId = null, 3000); }, 100); } toggleTodoStatus(id: string) { if (!this.conversation) return; const message = this.conversation.messages.find(m => !isSystemMessage(m) && (m as ConversationMessage).id === id) as ConversationMessage | undefined; if (message) { message.isTodo = !message.isTodo; // Notify parent if needed, though we update local state directly // Sync with backend would go here } } @ViewChild(RichTextEditorComponent) richTextEditor!: RichTextEditorComponent; handleDraftChange(content: string) { this.draftContent = content; if (this.messageId) { this.messagesService.setDraft(this.messageId, content); } } sendMessage() { if (!this.draftContent || !this.draftContent.trim() || !this.conversation || !this.messageId) return; // Mock send const newMessage: ConversationMessage = { id: `msg-${Date.now()}`, sender: 'You', content: this.draftContent, timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }), isOwn: true, isTodo: false }; this.conversation.messages = [...this.conversation.messages, newMessage]; // Clear local draft and service draft const id = this.messageId; this.draftContent = ''; this.messagesService.setDraft(id, ''); if (this.richTextEditor) { this.richTextEditor.clear(); } // Scroll to bottom setTimeout(() => { if (this.scrollBottom) { this.scrollBottom.nativeElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } }, 100); } }
